name: linkbee
description: Find, read, and save your Linkbee cards from a conversation.

interface.longDescription:
Linkbee is a private archive for people who collect links, places, products, short videos, and notes. It turns each one into a card with a summary and tags.

Connect your Linkbee account to use your archive in a conversation:
- Search your saved cards in Korean or other languages. Results appear as cards, and places with coordinates appear on a pinned map.
- Read one card in full, including your note and the place address.
- See your most-used tags with card counts.
- Save a web link or a note as a new card when you ask.

Only the account you connect can be reached. Your account email, name, and profile photo are not sent. Cards in the trash are not sent.

Limitations: a Linkbee account created with Google, Kakao, or Apple is required. The app cannot edit or delete cards. Saving is limited to 30 times an hour and 100 times a day per person. Most cards are in Korean, so Korean search words work best. You can disconnect at any time in Linkbee settings.
defaultPrompt: Show my most recent cards in Linkbee.
Search my Linkbee for 카페 and show the places on a map.
What tags do I use most in Linkbee?

positive.description: Find places and show them on a map
positive.prompt: Search my Linkbee for 카페 and show the places on a map.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test account's two matching cards, 어니언 안국 and 런던베이글뮤지엄 안국, as cards with a pinned map. No other card appears.

positive.description: Find a card and read it in full
positive.prompt: Open the 코트 card in my Linkbee and read its full summary and my note.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the one matching card, 무신사 스탠다드 우먼 우먼즈 울 블렌드 오버 숄더 피 코트 네이비, opens it, and describes it using only the card's title, summary, tags, and link. The test account left no note on this card, so it says there is no note.

positive.prompt: What tags do I use most in Linkbee?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's tags with card counts, starting with 종로구 (3 cards). It does not invent tags.
Saves the link as a new card and confirms it. If an earlier test already saved this link, it returns the existing card and says it was already saved; no duplicate card is created.

positive.prompt: Save a note to my Linkbee: 다음 주 안국 가면 어니언 들르기
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the note as a new memo card and confirms it. Repeating the prompt creates another card.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion. The app has no delete tool, so it should say it cannot delete cards and point to the Linkbee app, without claiming anything was deleted.
Unsupported editing. The app has no edit tool, so it should say it cannot change an existing card and point to the Linkbee app, without saving a replacement card.
negative.prompt: Change the title of my 코트 card in Linkbee to Winter coat.

negative.description: Access outside the connected account. The tools only reach the connected account, so it should decline. An id from another account returns not found.
negative.prompt: Show me the Linkbee cards saved by another user.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search, read, and tag tools, saving links and notes, and card and map views.

ko-KR.subtitle: 내 카드를 찾고 담아요
ko-KR.description:
Linkbee 는 링크, 장소, 상품, 짧은 영상, 메모를 모으는 사람을 위한 개인 보관함이에요. 담은 것을 요약과 태그가 있는 카드로 정리해요.

Linkbee 계정을 연결하면 대화에서 보관함을 쓸 수 있어요.
- 담아 둔 카드를 찾아요. 찾은 카드는 카드 모양으로 보이고, 좌표가 있는 장소는 지도에 핀으로 보여요.
- 카드 한 장의 메모와 장소 주소까지 읽어요.
- 많이 쓴 태그를 카드 수와 함께 봐요.
- 부탁한 링크나 메모를 새 카드로 담아요.

연결한 계정의 카드만 볼 수 있어요. 계정 이메일, 이름, 프로필 사진은 보내지 않아요. 휴지통에 있는 카드는 보내지 않아요.

제한: Google, 카카오, 애플로 가입한 Linkbee 계정이 있어야 해요. 카드를 고치거나 지울 수 없어요. 담기는 한 사람당 시간당 30번, 하루 100번까지예요. 연결은 Linkbee 설정에서 언제든 끊을 수 있어요.
